title: ToyOS evidence refresh prompts must skip the build loop
symptom: A prompt that asked to confirm current ToyOS build-report, generic-qemu-smoke-report, and score-report was routed into a build-first loop and started 'Build Toy OS baseline'.
root_cause: Planner fallback treated any ToyOS/QEMU prompt as a build-first request, and the surface router matched 'build' keywords before evidence-refresh intent.
fix: Add a dedicated ToyOS evidence-refresh planner branch that inspects existing artifacts without rebuilding.
Add a top-priority routing rule for ToyOS evidence refresh prompts so they land on review-oriented surfaces instead of Aider.
validation: OpenAIPlanner.build_plan now returns Review ToyOS evidence scope -> Inspect current ToyOS artifacts -> Emit ToyOS verification summary for the evidence-refresh prompt.
task-route now matches task_shape 'ToyOS evidence refresh' and selects Continue with launch_mode review.
